name: realinsight-connector-dev
description: Connect Codex to Realinsight records, analytics, configuration, and approved entity creation.

interface.longDescription: Work with the hosted Realinsight Streamable HTTP MCP server through secure customer-scoped authentication. View your current customer and environment, discover schema, search and read records, analyze dashboards and reports, and create entities with initial fields or update supported data and configuration after explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected Realinsight customer, server URL, and granted access.
Find a loan or property and show its key fields.
Validate creating a Realinsight entity with initial fields.
